title: Léo Pereira reaches historic milestone at Flamengo
seoTitle: Léo Pereira Reaches Historic Milestone at Flamengo
subtitle: Center-back records 100% passing and duel accuracy in match against Remo
excerpt: In the 1-0 win over Remo, Léo Pereira completed 86 passes and won every duel, an unprecedented feat in top leagues since 2016, consolidating his status.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Léo Pereira caught national attention by recording 86 passes with 100% accuracy and winning all seven duels he contested in the 1-0 victory over Remo, a match that placed the defender in the spotlight of Sofascore metrics.

Historic performance in match against Remo

The number 4 completed 86 passes without an error, won all seven duels, and neither committed a foul nor was dribbled past. According to Sofascore, no player across the world's top ten leagues had achieved the combination of 100% pass and duel completion in a single match since 2016.

Numbers reinforcing his efficiency

Beyond his accuracy, Léo Pereira recorded nine clearances, two tackles, 11 defensive actions, recovered the ball seven times, and delivered a key pass that contributed to the goal. These statistics showcase a complete performance, both in protecting the penalty area and in build-up play.

Evolution and fan trust

Having arrived at Flamengo surrounded by criticism, the 30-year-old center-back has regained the supporters' trust by improving his decision-making and consistency on the pitch since 2022. This shift in perception has turned him into one of the team's pillars in recent seasons.

Contract and future outlook

Under contract through 2027, Flamengo has already indicated that a renewal is a priority, reflecting the status Léo Pereira has earned. The last extension occurred in 2023, and the club intends to offer the defender a salary increase.

Legacy within Rubro-Negro history

With 16 trophies won since 2022, including two Copa Libertadores and two Copas do Brasil, Léo Pereira has joined the ranks of Flamengo's historic center-backs alongside figures like Mozer and Rondinelli, credited to his combination of individual performance and importance within a winning side.

With reporting from LANCE!, falandodeflamengo.com.br.
